name: gp163d_alien_invariant_bridge
rubric_version_reason: Successor substrate after local science-grade audit, invariant search, backtests, generator pass, and hostile audit. The goal is no longer raw chi4 phase fitting; it is to generate a cleaner law candidate, invariant packet, or no-go theorem for the diffuse internal-share susceptibility object.
description: Broad law-search substrate for a representation-stable diffuse susceptibility observable, explanatory primitive anchor, or no-go theorem for current gp163d internal-share candidates.

cage_meta.class_reason: Qualitative frontier law-search substrate over invariant candidates, explanatory bridges, and no-go statements.

disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: Qualitative frontier substrate; no direct numeric fit primitive.
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rivals are adjudicated by invariant quality, interpretation, and falsifier quality.
enable_fit_primitive_reason: This substrate searches for science objects and theorem-shaped bridges, not direct regression formulas.
persona: You are a ruthless alien-math nonlinear-gravity referee. Do not restate the old face-flux chi4 story. The live object is narrower: generate a representation-stable diffuse susceptibility observable, an explanatory bridge between the generated blend and the primitive internal-share anchor, or a no-go theorem explaining why the current family cannot promote beyond instrument science. Reward objects that separate diffuse from compact, survive admissible representation change in amplitude, cash out as explicit field/statistic definitions, and name a falsifier. Penalize raw phase rhetoric, generic smoothness, denominator-floor games, baseline-subtraction mirages, and astrophysical overclaim.

dimensions.name: Alien Invariant Ambition
dimensions.description: Does the submission propose a genuinely new observable, bridge, or no-go object beyond raw chi4 phase fitting?

dimensions.name: Diffuse-Compact Separation
dimensions.description: Does it preserve a large diffuse-vs-compact separation on the admissible representation set?

dimensions.name: Representation-Stability Cash-Out
dimensions.description: Does it improve or honestly interpret amplitude stability across face_flux and isotropic_18_flux?

dimensions.name: Explanatory Specificity
dimensions.description: Does it define explicit channel objects, blends, normalizations, or no-go claims precisely enough to falsify?

dimensions.name: Adversarial Falsifier Quality
dimensions.description: Does it name what would kill the proposal: denominator fragility, phase-only wins, halo-only pickup, compact-control leakage, or independent-solver collapse?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does it produce a law candidate, theorem packet, explanatory bridge, or decisive next discriminator?

dimensions.name: Scope Honesty And Nonclaim Control
dimensions.description: Does it avoid MOND/dark-matter overclaim and keep the distinction between solver science and astrophysical law explicit?

dimensions.name: Cost Reranking
dimensions.description: Does it say whether the next move is local backtest, independent solver/boundary test, or no-go closure rather than more same-family GPU spend?

criteria.Alien_Invariant_Ambition: Full credit requires a genuinely new observable, explanatory bridge, or no-go object that goes beyond repeating the current chi4 phase story or merely renaming the existing primitive/generated pair.
criteria.Diffuse_Compact_Separation: Full credit requires preserving a large diffuse-vs-compact separation on the admissible representation set, with the compact binary control staying operationally flat or safely small.
criteria.Representation_Stability_Cash_Out: Full credit requires either improving amplitude stability across face_flux and isotropic_18_flux or honestly explaining why the best object cannot do better without an independent implementation axis.
criteria.Explanatory_Specificity: Full credit requires explicit field/statistic definitions, blend rules, normalization logic, or theorem/no-go objects stated concretely enough to be falsified and audited.
criteria.Adversarial_Falsifier_Quality: Full credit requires naming what would kill the proposal: denominator fragility, phase-only wins, halo-only pickup, compact-control leakage, or collapse under an independent solver/boundary presentation.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires producing a law candidate, theorem packet, explanatory bridge, no-go theorem, or decisive next discriminator that changes what should be built or tested next.
criteria.Scope_Honesty_And_Nonclaim_Control: Reject any MOND/dark-matter victory language, astrophysical overclaim, or confusion between solver/object science and universe-level law.
criteria.Cost_Reranking: Full credit requires saying whether the next move should be a local hostile backtest, an independent implementation test, or closure rather than another same-family GPU sweep.

success_criteria: A cleaner internal-share / internal-channel observable that beats the current generated blend or primitive anchor under the existing local backtests.
An explanatory theorem packet showing why the blend improves amplitude stability without becoming a denominator-floor artifact.
A no-go theorem proving the current family cannot become a physics law without an independent implementation axis.
A decisive reranking that identifies the cheapest next discriminating test.
failure_modes: Restating raw chi4 phase fits as if phase non-invariance were solved.
Using mu or total_g smoothness as the main claim object rather than as a baseline.
Winning only by denominator or sign instability.
Calling a representation-stable amplitude object an astrophysical MOND/AQUAL law.
Asking for more same-family GPU runs without a stronger local discriminator.
